thread.title: Dunkin' Stock Surges To New High; Amazon Hits $1 Trillion Market Cap

author: KEN SHREVE
title: Dunkin' Stock Surges To New High; Amazon Hits $1 Trillion Market Cap

organizations.name: dunkin' stock surges to new high

text:
Shares of Dunkin' Brands ( DNKN ) surged to a new high Tuesday. The strong move for Dunkin' stock comes after Coca-Cola ( KO ) announced plans to buy U.K.-based Costa Coffee for just over $5 billion. That's fueling speculation that Dunkin' could be a takeover target itself at some point.
X Dunkin' stock is still in buy range after gapping out of a flat base Tuesday with a 73.59 entry.
Meanwhile, two top retail stocks that broke out Friday followed through with conviction Monday. Shares of Lululemon Athletica ( LULU ) added another 2% after soaring nearly 13% Friday. Ulta Beauty ( ULTA ) tacked on more than 4% after surging nearly 8% last week.
Other new highs in the retail sector Tuesday came from Burlington Stores ( BURL ), Ollie's Bargain Outlet ( OLLI ) and Five Below ( FIVE ). All three are extended from buy areas. Earnings from Ollie's Bargain Outlet are due Wednesday after the close. Results from Five Below are due Thursday after the close.
Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) also hit a new high ahead of its Thursday earnings report . But the security software name faded from an early gain. It's still holding above the 219.48 entry.
Results from HealthEquity ( HQY ) are due today after the close . Shares hit a new high Tuesday, but it's extended from a proper entry after a breakout from a base in early May.
Among the FAANG stocks, Amazon.com ( AMZN ) scored a new high and also topped $1 trillion in market capitalization . Shares hit an intraday high of 2,046.83, up 1.7% after a New York Times report said the company is getting ready to take on Facebook ( FB ) and Google parent Alphabet ( GOOGL ) in the $88 billion online ad market.
